findings.current: An uncertain instinct, closer to a wild guess—one even Jin Taekyung could hardly make sense of.
findings.defect: The source describes an intuition close to an awkward fantasy or delusion, not a guess. “Wild guess” shifts the kind of intuition being described.
findings.rationale: The Korean says 어설픈 공상에 가까운 직감: an intuition close to an awkward or poorly formed fantasy.
findings.replacement: An uncertain instinct, closer to a half-baked fantasy—one even Jin Taekyung could hardly make sense of.

findings.current: That was precisely why they couldn’t let him sacrifice himself in vain.
findings.defect: “Sacrifice himself” makes Jin Taekyung the agent of the sacrifice. The source says they could not let him be sacrificed in vain, without specifying that he would sacrifice himself.
findings.rationale: The source uses 덧없이 희생시킬 수 없었고, describing the group not letting him be sacrificed pointlessly.
findings.replacement: That was precisely why they couldn’t let him be sacrificed in vain.

findings.current: At least, Choi Minwoo didn’t waver until he heard Jin Taekyung’s answer.
findings.defect: This makes Choi Minwoo’s composure the thing that held until the reply. The source’s “At least” qualifies the preceding claim about the barrier’s backlash; Minwoo’s eyes widening is narrated afterward.
findings.rationale: The source says 적어도, 뒤이어 들려온 진태경의 대답을 듣기 전까지는 그랬다: at least, that was the case until he heard the answer.
findings.replacement: At least, that was what Choi Minwoo thought—until he heard Jin Taekyung’s answer.

summary: The chapter is largely faithful, but a few lines shift or omit specific meaning from the source.
